data_a.situation: Calder Vossine asked Neris Holbeck to re-bush a worn pivot on JC-5624 after a lunchtime inspection.
known_facts: JC-5624 is the assembly-rooms going train.
The pivot was worn enough to need a bush; the re-bush is now complete.
Calder had earlier said the pivot looked serviceable from the tower floor.
A short completion note was requested.
constraints: Keep the note to Calder Vossine only.

turns.input_raw:
Please review this completion note to Calder.
